in_marathi.name: Kusumita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kusumita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Kusuma’ which means ‘flower’, and ‘ita’ which means ‘bud’. In Hindu mythology, Kusumita represents the youthful and budding stage of life.
